sentiment: Privacy is not a locked door — it is the room you build around yourself.

stories.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
stories.summary: Google advances fully homomorphic encryption to keep AI processing private end-to-end, even the model never sees the raw data.

stories.title: Going Dark, and the era of law enforcement hacking
stories.summary: Law enforcement's increasing reliance on hacking devices rather than warrants raises hard questions about the boundaries of state power.

stories.title: RustDesk now supports true unattended remote access on Wayland
stories.summary: RustDesk's new Wayland-native mode removes the last dependency on X11 for truly headless Linux remote access.
